title: A call switches the connected alarm system
body_md: In the switch positions provided for it, Pro-finder ends a call to the number of the inserted card automatically, switches the connected alarm system to the other state, and sends a status report to the caller after successful switching. The source restricts this to authorised numbers.
source_region: Section 1.3, function on activating/deactivating the alarm system
prev_context: Before this stands the geofencing function.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 9: equivalent in substance. The English version names the alarm system with its version number here, the German one without – a naming difference without consequence.
